# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform support and eliminates avoidable native and managed memory overhead. This update refreshes native build and packaging support across Windows, Apple platforms, Linux, and WebGPU while making image, text, stream, and string handling more efficient and reliable.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture presentation synchronized** — Texture rendering now follows the display refresh cycle, improving the consistency of front-buffered rendering on Android. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native string creation made safe** — Creating SKData from C strings no longer risks reading past the native buffer and writes directly into the managed data object. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies use less managed overhead** — Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary work, reducing overhead when moving pixel data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text and stream handling retain fewer native resources** — Feature-string decoding avoids a native allocation, HarfBuzz UTF-32 conversion reuses buffers, and front-buffered streams no longer retain resources unnecessarily. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Apple platform deployment baselines updated** — Apple targets now use newer deployment minimums; verify that applications target supported OS versions before updating. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **Native packages updated across Windows, Linux, and WebGPU** — Windows native and ANGLE builds use the modern Visual Studio toolchain, Linux resolves bundled HarfBuzz functions locally, and the WebGPU implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
